links.comparator_used: No formal comparator; MC dropout uncertainty maps were checked against observed HU, range, WET and dose errors between sCT and planning CT (sCT point estimate without uncertainty map is the implicit alternative)
links.outcome: Correlation of voxel-wise uncertainty maps with HU, range, WET and dose errors of synthetic CTs
links.effect: DCNN and cycleGAN: uncertainty-HU r = 0.92 ± 0.03 and 0.92 ± 0.03; uncertainty-range r = 0.66 ± 0.09 and 0.62 ± 0.06; uncertainty-WET r = 0.64 ± 0.06 and 0.58 ± 0.07; uncertainty-dose difference r = 0.65 ± 0.09 and 0.67 ± 0.07
links.tradeoff: Each sCT needed 10 inferences with dropout active. Correlations with range, WET and dose errors were only moderate compared with HU errors.
links.quote: The observed correlations between uncertainty maps and the various metrics (HU, range, WET, and dose errors) demonstrated the potential of MCD-based uncertainty maps as a reliable QA tool to evaluate the accuracy of deep learning-based sCTs.

design_hint: Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty maps as QA check for synthetic CTs
